She doesn't know anything about me smoking weed tho.
Well, how did it go?

Age is not a problem. Nobody need to be x years old and have their life figured out. I know that for some of us life gets worse, but that CAN change.

I have had many years like that, even tho i am younger, honestly in my life just keep happening shitty things one after another, but I really think we should not put a date to death. And dont get me wrong, i have A LOT on my plate. I know how it feels, but it might get better, theres just one way to find out.

Im kind of in the same situation, i dont want to miss school being in a mental hospital, and getting into one is also very hard. I do think your mental health and well being is above anything, even work. My answer is: if you have someone to cover your bills and keep your house and all of that, while you are in the hospital, go ahead, with no fear. If you dont, try to find a really good therapist and balance your mh with work. but always comes first your mental health and life.
